@graph.description: Root RO-Crate descriptor for the FTRO walking skeleton repository. NOTE: this describes the repository as a research object for FAIR discoverability. This crate does not claim conformance to the FTRO profile. contentSize is deliberately omitted for this entity: it describes the file it is written into, so any value is stale the moment it is serialised.
